title: Two minutes of pinyin out loud
summary: Read pinyin aloud for two minutes daily to connect the spelling to a sound you can produce.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Pinyin is a code for sound, so it has to be decoded out loud to be learned. Silently scanning it builds recognition but not a mouth. Set a two-minute timer, pick any page of pinyin, and read every syllable as if a listener needs to understand you. When you hit a syllable you cannot place, stop and split it into initial, final, and tone, then say the three pieces in order. Two minutes is short on purpose: it is easy to keep going daily, and daily beats long.
